title: Normalize Sequence Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the wave-4 consistency contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled SequenceLabels struct+consts+resolver and action-label map, adopt SDK testkit (meta/new_app/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) for the three generic test bodies, confirm selection_ids delegates to the SDK version, fix region naming/order (rename tests region to 🧪Tests, canonical order), verify C1 app struct naming (already SequencePlayApp) and C4 (single-app crate stays flat).
summary: Normalized sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the wave-4 consistency contract. Adopted SDK PanelKit (tree_item_desc/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder from semio_framework_plugin) in build_document_tree and build_catalogue_tree, deleting this crate's local tree_item/tree_item_with_action duplicates (this also fixes a latent gap: the local UiTreeSectionNode literals were missing the `loading` field the SDK type now carries — PanelTreeBuilder supplies it). Adopted SDK Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled SequenceLabels struct + SEQUENCE_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + sequence_labels() resolver with the app_labels! macro + resolve_labels::<SequenceLabels>(), replaced the manual (id,en,de)-map builder with localized_label_map, and replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct-literal in app_labels() with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels — confirmed no .app_label() exists, matching the prior agent's finding). selection_ids (~line 920 pre-refactor) now delegates its `ids`-array parsing to semio_framework_plugin::selection_ids (aliased sdk_selection_ids) and keeps only this app's nodeId fallback locally, per the SDK doc's explicit note that sequence is one of the apps keeping a local wrapper. Adopted SDK Testkit: replaced local meta()/new_app() and the three generic test bodies (undo/redo round trip, two-instance convergence, ingest idempotency) with semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, assert_undo_redo_round_trip, assert_two_instances_converge, assert_ingest_idempotent}, keeping this app's own action names/args/probes. App-unique tests left untouched. Regions: merged the non-canonical TreeHelpers region into DocumentHelpers (only tree_item/tree_item_with_action moved to the SDK; is_control_kind/control_slots/slot_label/build_step_tree_item are per-app business logic and stayed), confirmed 🔖Manifest was already correctly named, and wrapped the test module in //#region 🧪Tests / //#endregion 🧪Tests (previously unwrapped). Canonical region order (Constants, Types, DocumentHelpers, Terminology, CommandLabels, Panels, Render, SequencePlayApp, Manifest, Tests) confirmed already correct. C1: app struct is already `SequencePlayApp` = PascalCase("sequence-play") + "App" — no rename needed; grepped the whole sequence/ directory and found zero other references. C4: single-app crate, stays flat (no pub mod wrapper) — verified only one `impl DocumentApp for X` in the crate. C6: Cargo.toml has no app-to-app plugin dependency. resource_kind(...) already present on the AppBuilder chain (Wave-1 work), verified only. Ran `rustfmt --config-path rustfmt.toml --edition 2021` on the file to bring it to a clean state (0-diff on --check), matching the already-migrated sibling crate mathematical/plugin/rs/lib.rs.
